adds.functionality: Each enemy-faction pawn death adds 12 h (cap 360 h) to a per-faction cooldown before that faction can raid again; optional cooldown readout on the faction screen. Harmony patch on IncidentWorker_RaidEnemy.FactionCanBeGroupSource (dll_flags: harmony, game_component_tick, settings_screen)

verdict_reason: It softens raid cadence: more kills mean fewer raids. The campaign's pressure is meant to be qualitative and story-driven (Empire pursuer, Hutt ledger, Ta'Baa clock; brief section 1 and the pillars in section 2), not tuned by a body-count timer. Our own Aftermath mod already treats it as an obstacle: AftermathRuleRunner.cs sets forced = true with a comment recording a CONFIRMED bypass of exactly this mod's FactionCanBeGroupSource patch, and Aftermath lists it in loadAfter (load order only, not a dependency). So nothing needs it, but the interplay with the Empire escalation design (design/Jawa/proposals/empire_escalation_ladder_design_2026-10-02.md names it) is undecided; keep until the owner rules on whether raid cadence may be player-influenced.
